description: Source code implementing ASN.1 structures and functions for X.509 v3 extensions in OpenSSL, including GENERAL_NAME, OTHERNAME, and EDIPARTYNAME.

methods.name: GENERAL_NAME_cmp
methods.description: Compares two GENERAL_NAME structures for equality.

methods.name: GENERAL_NAME_set0_value
methods.description: Sets the value and type of a GENERAL_NAME structure.

methods.name: GENERAL_NAME_get0_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value and type from a GENERAL_NAME structure.

methods.name: GENERAL_NAME_set0_othername
methods.description: Sets an OTHERNAME in a GENERAL_NAME structure.

methods.name: GENERAL_NAME_get0_otherName
methods.description: Retrieves the otherName and its object identifier from a GENERAL_NAME.
